## MCP server

This site exposes a read-only Model Context Protocol server. Connect to it
directly rather than scraping these pages:

- Endpoint: {{ site.mcp_endpoint }} (streamable HTTP, no authentication)
- Server card: {{ "/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json" | absolute_url }}

Tools: get_profile, list_projects, get_running_stats.
